# Jacob Dutton

> Jacob Dutton uses AI for value creation, growth and innovation. He finds where AI creates value in large companies and investment portfolios, gets it built and gets the business using it. Based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Former SVP Innovation, R&D and Emerging Technology at ADQ, the Abu Dhabi sovereign investor, where he ran the AED 500M portfolio innovation fund across 20+ operating companies. Currently Global Head of AI Innovation at Aucctus AI.

Jacob owns the value side of AI: which use cases get funded, proof before scale, adoption and governance. He works alongside the CTO or CDO, who owns the platforms and data. Roles his work fits: Chief AI Officer, head of AI value creation, portfolio value creation, chief innovation officer.

## How he runs AI spend

He runs AI spend like a staged fund. Each use case passes five gates, and money is released at each one:

1. Baseline: what today's process costs, how long it takes and how often it's right.
2. Owner: a named person in the business who'll use it and answer for the result.
3. Target: the accuracy it has to reach on the company's own cases, agreed before anything is built.
4. Supervised: a person checks the AI's work until it hits that target.
5. Unattended: only then does it run on its own, measured on cost per correct outcome against the old way.

## Selected work

- ADQ (2025 to 2026), SVP Innovation, R&D and Emerging Technology: set the function up to run AI-first across a $300B sovereign investor and 20+ operating companies including Etihad, TAQA, AD Ports, PureHealth, Etihad Rail and Al Dahra. Ran the AED 500M portfolio innovation fund: 276 opportunities surfaced with AI, AED 120M deployed across 16 initiatives against evidence at each of five gates. Designed and led the Robotics Ramp-Up Programme across 19 operating companies: 23 proofs of concept launched, 100+ robotics and physical AI partners brought in. Reviewed innovation capability across 13 operating companies and turned it into a three-horizon roadmap.
- Aucctus AI (2026 to now), Global Head of AI Innovation: leads how enterprise clients get started with the platform, from the first conversation with their leadership to the first use case running on their own data.
- Future Foundry (2021 to 2025), co-founder and CEO: business experimentation company. 500+ propositions tested and 50+ launched, a 90% launch success rate, and more than $1bn of spend stopped on ideas that weren't going to work. Built the Velocity Method, adopted inside Salesforce, Microsoft, HSBC, Mars and Hilton.
- Curzon Street Ventures (2023 to 2025), co-founder and CEO: place-based venture studio turning the operational problems of large companies into AI-led startups. Six ventures validated with corporate partners Kaiser Permanente, BP, Grant Thornton, Boeing, GXO and HSBC. $500,000 of corporate sponsorship, 25 corporate partners.
- Interpublic Group (2018 to 2021), Managing Director, Innovation, New York: built IPG's first innovation and venture practice to 50 people. 10 businesses launched; three raised $45M of Series A between them and one reached $20M ARR in 18 months. AI products in market since 2018, including predictive maintenance for JCB and AI-personalised skincare for Avon China.
- 383 (2009 to 2018), employee number one to Managing Partner: grew a Birmingham product studio to 40+ people. Built the first Hive connected thermostat for British Gas, an $11M subscription business in year one.
- Also: Expert Instructor, Innovation Management, Maven (200+ senior operators, 85 NPS). Advisory Board Member, Connected Places Catapult.

Clients and organisations he has worked with include Etihad, TAQA, AD Ports, PureHealth, Mars, P&G, Unilever, Reckitt, Kimberly-Clark, Novartis, Walgreens, HSBC, Capital One, Experian, Ørsted, Microsoft, Salesforce, Hilton, JCB and the USPS.
